purpose: Executable-field-aligned natural-language assessment catalog; full-release numeric gold must be independently materialized after data generation.

common_contract.money: CNY integer cents excluding VAT; no VAT simulation
common_contract.cash: successful payment amounts minus successful refunds; no failed attempts or duplicate callbacks
common_contract.business_as_of: exclusive upper bound on actual business event time
common_contract.reference_time: fixed historical anchor for relative natural language; does not replace either data cutoff
common_contract.future_plans: planned_at/target month may lie in the future if the plan was available before knowledge_as_of; do not apply actual-event cutoff blindly to plan effective dates
common_contract.tenant_scope: current authenticated tenant; Q28 explicitly tests denial of another tenant
common_contract.budget_grain: target_monthly: tenant × month × channel × region × metric_code × plan_version; no category/store/campaign budgets
common_contract.inventory_valuation: use core.inventory_valuation_snapshot historical original-lot value; never latest SKU cost times historical quantity
common_contract.campaign_versions: latest available report_version per original campaign_daily grain before aggregation
common_contract.query_order: filter authorized scope and observation visibility; aggregate each fact at its correct grain; only then join aggregates
common_contract.payment_time_v1_assumption: attempted_at represents an immediate terminal cash result for SUCCEEDED rows; if settlement can be delayed, migrate cash queries to an explicit succeeded/settled timestamp
common_contract.evaluation_context_metadata: required_principal_all_regions fixes the authenticated principal all_regions value required before executing this question; inventory_source_mode identifies the trusted broker historical replay input. These are evaluation/broker metadata, not new schema columns, and never authorize changing a principal or elevating permissions.

materialization_boundary.fixture_questions: Numeric golden results are available in golden_fixture.json and independently checked by run_golden_fixture.mjs.
materialization_boundary.canonical_questions: This catalog provides required real schema fields, query logic and output shape; it does not claim the million-order release or 30 canonical gold SQL files already exist.
materialization_boundary.scenario_refs: S01-S08 follow docs/technical_design.md section 11; bind these logical tags to concrete eval.scenario IDs during release assembly. Routine fixture boundaries use null unless a main-document scenario applies.
materialization_boundary.schedule_alert_questions: Q26/Q27 include runtime workflow checks; business data alone cannot prove a task was scheduled or a notification delivered.

questions.question_text: 给我看上个月本企业在我授权区域内的净销售额、商品毛利、同比和预算达成，做成经营总览。

steps: 分别将 revenue_entry 和 cost_entry 按 recognized_at 的 2025-11 月及 2024-11 月聚合；所有事实 available_at < knowledge_as_of。
销售与成本通过 order_unit→order_header 获取渠道；各事实先按同一粒度汇总，再连接，避免分录相乘。
target_monthly 仅选 NET_SALES，月份×渠道×大区，取 approved_at 与 available_at 在知识截止前的最新 plan_version。
总毛利率=总毛利/总净销售；同比基期为零、净销售非正或预算为零时返回空比率并说明。
notes: Q01 严格本租户，不因岗位为总经理而跨租户。

steps: 先由可信 broker 按本题 knowledge_as_of 截取源流水及必要父记录 available_at 严格早于该截止的完整库存事务，重放至 business_as_of 之前对应的上海业务日末，提供与 core.inventory_snapshot 同列的历史数量快照关系；题目消费该关系。禁止通过过滤 final_restated 快照的 available_at 恢复历史库存。

questions.question_text: 各门店近 28 天的库存周转怎么样？找出库存金额高、动销低的门店。

context.relative_time_rule: Resolve relative words against reference_time, never the machine clock.

steps: 先验证当前已认证身份属于 tenant 101、all_regions=true 且具有成本权限；三项均满足才执行本题，输出仍按门店。前置条件不满足时报告不可按本题金标计算，不修改身份或扩大授权。
成本使用 recognized_at 落在 2025-11-03 至 2025-12-01 的净 cost_entry，通过 order_unit→shipment_item.from_site_id 归属原出库门店；库存金额也按同一 site_id 统计，不用 selling_site_id 替代履约地点。
库存金额由可信 broker 按本题 knowledge_as_of 对当时可见的完整库存事务及原批次成本重放，提供 28 个目标业务日、与 core.inventory_valuation_snapshot 同列的历史估值关系；使用其中 sellable_value_cent。禁止过滤 final_restated 快照恢复历史，也不能混入其他知识版本。
每天先汇总该门店可售库存原批次成本，再对 28 个自然日求平均；禁止用最新 SKU 成本乘历史库存，禁止平均 SKU 周转率。
周转=期间净 COGS/平均每日库存金额。零分母、净 COGS 为负、日数据不全分别标识；不静默补齐缺日。
notes: 本题明确采用原出库地点的净销售成本与该地点平均可售库存金额。成交门店销售绩效属于另一指标，不能混入库存周转分子。
历史快照是可信 broker 依据已授权、当时可见源流水产生的派生关系，须匹配 release、授权范围、业务截止及 knowledge_as_of；缓存物化时间不是源业务记录的 available_at，不能用它替代源可见性过滤。该前置能力仍按主文作为 broker 实施任务。
本题固定全区域授权，因为库存按实物地点区域过滤、销售成本按原订单销售区域过滤；有限区域身份可能看到门店完整库存却只看到部分履约成本，不能据此输出该门店完整周转率。
